# Answerfinch

> Answerfinch is a Google Forms™ add-on that sends emails based on form answers. You choose a question, a condition and who gets the email. For example, email billing when someone requests a refund. Free plan: one rule at a time across your Google account, with every condition type. Pro: $4 a month or $29 a year, taxes included.

Answerfinch is made by Lazy Labs. It is not related to other products named Finch. It runs in Google Forms and is installed from the Google Workspace Marketplace.

## Product

- [Home](https://answerfinch.com/): what Answerfinch does, pricing and limits
- [Install from Google Workspace Marketplace](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/answerfinch_conditional_email_notificati/602427031339?utm_source=answerfinch.com&utm_medium=help&utm_campaign=llms)

- [Email different people based on checkbox answers](https://answerfinch.com/help/email-recipients-by-checkbox-answer.html): Send each selected option to the team that needs it.
- [Send a different confirmation by answer](https://answerfinch.com/help/different-confirmation-emails-by-answer.html): Send different instructions to respondents based on one choice.

- [Send email by answer with Apps Script](https://answerfinch.com/help/apps-script-email-by-form-answer.html): Try a form submit trigger and decide when to keep your own code.
